title: Claude Code auto memory forgets entries once MEMORY.md passes 200 lines or 25KB
symptoms: Facts saved to auto memory are unknown in a new session
Only entries near the top of MEMORY.md are reflected
After a write, Claude Code tells Claude the memory index is over its read limit
cause: Only the first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md, whichever comes first, load at the start of a session; the rest is dropped. Topic files load only when Claude chooses to read them.
fix: Keep MEMORY.md as an index with one short line per entry and move detail into topic files the index points to. Merge or delete stale entries.
apply: wc -l -c ~/.claude/projects/*/memory/MEMORY.md   # keep each under 200 lines and 25KB
affected: Claude Code auto memory, as of 2026-10
